lesson.evidence: Exact brute-force found optimal 3-set solution. Atlas, beacon, cipher form a perfect partition (e01-e06, e07-e12, e13-e18). Greedy matched optimum. Randomized trials (12 seeds) produced size 3-5 solutions; seed 1 chose 4 sets when randomness picked drift early.
lesson.statement: Partition-structured set covers allow optimal exact solutions at small scale; randomized greedy degrades when early picks fragment the partition.

summary: Randomized greedy: 12 trials, best 3 sets, worst 5 sets
Local search refinement: all 12 trials converged to 3 sets
Final verified: 3 sets cover all 18 elements with no duplicates
